scope: Independent review of the root integration workflow and four existing browser-regression helper diffs; no product or test files edited.
findings: All 53 original Python assertions and 21 Playwright expect checks are preserved; additions do not soften existing checks.
Construction flow uses real public practice, work and next-work controls. No new forced clicks or game-state injection.

Workflow checkout selects PR head SHA or event SHA. Push execution waits for nine public runtime-file hashes to match checkout before passing --base-url to the browser helper.
Source-wait, browser failure and missing-artifact paths remain failures; artifacts are uploaded even after failed checks.
notYetVerified: Two new Stage 4 browser helpers were not available at review time; their source-response binding and report limitations remain for later review.
Product DOM selectors and manual work/next runtime behavior await completed implementations.
Image fallback, expected image counts and actual new-scene PNG visibility await implementation and browser evidence.
No Stage 4 browser execution, physical-device touch or audible playback is certified by this static review.
